normas.texto: Error messages must: (a) exist in the DOM as text (not only color or icon), (b) be linked to the offending input via aria-describedby, (c) use aria-invalid='true' on the input, (d) describe the error and how to fix it. Error summary at the top of the page is recommended for multi-field forms.

normas.texto: Every form input must have a programmatically associated label via: (a) <label> element with for attribute matching the input's id, (b) aria-label attribute, or (c) aria-labelledby pointing to a visible label element. alegacao.observado: O radio "Presencial" não tem nome acessível: o <label>Presencial</label> não tem atributo for nem envolve o input; a árvore de acessibilidade expõe "radio" sem nome, e clicar no texto "Presencial" não seleciona a opção (elementFromPoint no círculo atinge o label; checked continua false).
alegacao.esperado: Rótulo associado ao input (label for="forma-presencial"), com nome acessível "Presencial" e clique no rótulo selecionando a opção.

normaCitada.texto: Every form input must have a programmatically associated label via: (a) <label> element with for attribute matching the input's id, (b) aria-label attribute, or (c) aria-labelledby pointing to a visible label element. Placeholder text is NOT a substitute for a label — it disappears on input and is not consistently announced by all screen readers.
